vendors.name: Gestion BTP
vendors.tagline: Logiciel web de gestion BTP et comptabilité pour entreprises marocaines : devis, factures, chantiers
vendors.market_position: Gestion BTP is a web-based construction management and accounting product for Moroccan firms, published by SAEL TECH & APPS of Marrakech. Its pricing page says the Entreprise licence covers worksites, quotes and invoices, time tracking, payroll, accounting and DGI and CNSS exports. It runs in the browser, can be installed as a web app, and has open demo accounts for each of its 13 user roles.
pros: Built for Moroccan construction firms
Published prices, from 950 MAD HT a month
Quotes, invoices, worksites, time tracking, payroll and accounting in one web app, per the vendor
Open demo accounts and a free 30-minute demo
cons: No free trial: the vendor says so on its pricing page
Annual billing on a 12-month contract, plus a one-time setup fee of 999 to 4,999 MAD HT
DGI and CNSS handling is described as exports; confirm what is filed for you on the demo
No company registration number on its legal page
vendors.typical_pricing: Published: 950 MAD HT a month for auto-entrepreneurs (one user, up to 25 projects), 1,500 MAD HT a month for construction firms (up to 50 projects) and 2,250 MAD HT a month for property developers (up to 100 projects); extra internal users 650 MAD HT a month each; billed annually on a 12-month contract, plus a one-time setup and training fee of 999 to 4,999 MAD HT. No free trial.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Gestion BTP's pricing page says the Entreprise licence includes payroll and DGI and CNSS exports, and prices are in dirhams excluding 20% VAT. Ask on the free demo which Moroccan tax and CNSS steps it completes for you and which it only exports, before relying on it for compliance.

vendors.name: EBP Bâtiment (Édition Maroc)
vendors.tagline: Devis, factures et situations de travaux pour le bâtiment, Édition Maroc d'EBP
vendors.market_position: EBP Maroc, the Rabat subsidiary of French publisher EBP (part of the Cegid group since July 2024), sells three Bâtiment editions for Morocco: ACTIV, PRO and ELITE. All three cover quotes, orders, invoices, situations de travaux, progress invoices and retenue de garantie; PRO adds worksite tracking and staff and equipment planning, and ELITE adds a Gantt chart and tender imports. The software runs on Windows and is sold by EBP Maroc and its reseller partners.
pros: Moroccan editions of all three Bâtiment products
Situations de travaux, progress invoices and retenue de garantie built in
ACTIV imports the Batiprix and BatiChiffrage libraries
30-day free trial
Rabat office plus resellers in Casablanca, Rabat and Agadir
cons: No public prices; every edition is on quote
Windows only
No payroll product on ebp.ma
Accounting is a separate EBP product
PRO includes 1 user and up to 3 companies
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices. EBP Maroc lists ACTIV, PRO and ELITE as 'Tarif sur devis'. 30-day free trial.
vendors.ma_specific_note: EBP says ACTIV was created and adapted for Moroccan companies. Accounting is a separate product (EBP Comptabilité, Édition Maroc, with TVA declaration) and ebp.ma lists no payroll product, so plan a separate payroll tool. EBP Maroc sells from Rabat and through partners in Casablanca, Rabat-Kénitra-Salé and Agadir.

vendors.name: Sage Batigest Connect
vendors.tagline: Logiciel Sage de devis, métré, facturation et suivi de chantier pour le bâtiment
vendors.market_position: Sage Batigest Connect is Sage's building-trade software for quotes, measurements (métré), invoicing and worksite tracking, with a mobile app for following sites. In Morocco it is offered through resellers such as Ciel Informatique in Casablanca, which sells it alongside Sage 100 for accounting. Sage's Moroccan website could not be read for this check, so confirm the Moroccan edition and support terms with Sage or the reseller.
pros: Quotes, métré, invoicing and worksite tracking in one tool
Mobile app for following worksites
Budget vs actual cost analysis per site
Team scheduling and timesheets
Free trial offered by the Moroccan reseller
cons: No public prices in Morocco
Accounting is a separate Sage product
Moroccan tax and payroll features not described on the pages read
Bought through resellers; Sage's Moroccan site gives no detail that could be checked
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices in Morocco. Ciel Informatique quotes on request and offers a free trial.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Sage Batigest Connect is offered in Morocco through resellers such as Ciel Informatique (Casablanca), which also sells Sage 100 for accounting. The reseller page does not describe Moroccan TVA, CNSS or e-invoicing features for Batigest itself, so ask for a demonstration on Moroccan invoices before buying.

vendors.name: Odoo (BTP, via intégrateurs marocains)
vendors.tagline: ERP intégré avec localisation comptable marocaine et un package entrepreneur général : devis, chantiers, achats, facturation
vendors.market_position: Odoo is an ERP suite from Odoo SA with apps for CRM, sales, invoicing, purchasing, projects, timesheets, accounting and payroll, in an open-source Community edition and a licensed Enterprise edition. Its General Contractor industry package adds signed online quotes, progress invoicing, cost tracking against estimates and change orders. Odoo ships a Morocco accounting localization and lists 19 implementation partners in Morocco.
pros: Quotes, projects, purchasing, invoicing and accounting in one system
General Contractor package with progress invoicing and change orders
Moroccan chart of accounts and tax report included
Morocco listed among Odoo's payroll localizations
Published prices and a free One App plan
cons: Payroll and mobile apps need the paid Enterprise edition
Launch discount lasts only the first 12 months
Implementation, Odoo.sh hosting and in-app credits cost extra
No Morocco-specific page in Odoo's documentation
vendors.typical_pricing: Published on odoo.com (read in USD): One App Free $0 (one app, unlimited users); Standard $7.25 per user per month billed yearly or $9.10 billed monthly for the first 12 months (regular $8.95 or $11.20); Custom $13.40 yearly or $16.90 monthly (regular $16.40 or $20.90). Light users US$2.90. Implementation and Odoo.sh hosting extra.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Odoo's Morocco accounting module (Moroccan chart of accounts and tax report) is open source and installs with Accounting, and Morocco is on Odoo's list of payroll localizations (Enterprise). Odoo lists 19 implementation partners in Morocco. Prices were read in USD; check the dirham price when you order.

vendors.name: Hisab
vendors.tagline: Facturation en ligne pour PME et fiduciaires marocaines : factures FR/AR, export UBL 2.1, archivage 10 ans
vendors.market_position: Hisab is an online invoicing platform for Moroccan SMEs and accounting firms, launched in early 2026 and operated under its terms by Boltpath LLC, a New Mexico (US) company. It creates invoices in French and Arabic, exports UBL 2.1 and CII files, and offers e-signature and 10-year archiving. Hisab says more than 250 companies have signed up; it is not a construction tool.
pros: Published prices, from 1,490 MAD a year
Invoices in French and Arabic
UBL 2.1 and CII export, e-signature and 10-year archiving
14-day free trial, no card
Multi-company console for accounting firms
cons: No worksite or progress-billing features described
Young product, launched in early 2026
Operated by a US company; monthly plans billed in USD via Paddle
Starter covers 1 user and 200 invoices a month
Does not claim DGI accreditation
vendors.typical_pricing: Published, billed yearly: Starter 1,490 MAD (shown as 124 MAD a month; 1 user, 200 invoices a month), Pro 3,490 MAD (291 MAD a month; 3 users), Comptable 9,990 MAD (833 MAD a month; 10 client entities). Monthly billing in USD via Paddle: about $15, $35 or $100. Enterprise on quote. Hisab calls the MAD prices indicative. 14-day free trial.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Hisab says it is ready for the DGI's 2026 e-invoicing mandate and will submit invoices to the DGI for validation; it does not claim DGI accreditation. Le360, citing Challenge (June 2026), reports the rollout starts in 2026 with about 1,655 companies with turnover above 200 million dirhams, reaching SMEs in 2027-2028 and small firms after 2028.

vendors.name: Fawatir AI
vendors.tagline: Facturation, devis, caisse, stock et paie pour TPE et auto-entrepreneurs marocains, avec copilote IA
vendors.market_position: Fawatir AI is a Moroccan online app for invoices, quotes, point of sale, stock, payroll and accounting preparation, with an AI copilot that turns voice or text messages in French, Arabic or Darija into invoices, quotes or expense records. It targets shops, auto-entrepreneurs, freelancers, small businesses and accounting firms, including construction firms. Fawatir AI says 214 Moroccan companies use it.
pros: Published yearly price covering all modules
Payroll with CNSS, AMO and IR calculations, per the vendor
AI copilot accepts French, Arabic or Darija
Free trial with no card and a 30-day money-back guarantee
Free access for the client's accountant
cons: No worksite or progress-billing features described
Not certified or accredited by the DGI, by its own statement
Free trial limited to 3 invoices and 3 quotes
No legal entity or address in its terms
vendors.typical_pricing: Published: Pro 1,699 DH a year (all modules, unlimited documents), or 999 DH a year if paid within 7 days of sign-up. Extra team member 299 DH a year; extra company 999 DH a year. Free trial with 3 invoices and 3 quotes. Billed yearly by bank transfer; VAT treatment not stated.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Fawatir AI says its invoices carry the mandatory Moroccan mentions (ICE, IF, TVA) and that its payroll calculates CNSS, AMO and IR. It also states that it is not certified, accredited or approved by the DGI, does not transmit invoices to the tax administration, and that the official e-invoicing calendar and format for SMEs and the self-employed are not yet published.

vendors.name: Aube
vendors.tagline: Devis, factures, avoirs et situations pour PME marocaines, avec recherche ICE et TVA par ligne
vendors.market_position: Aube is an online invoicing app published by Aisobotics SARL in Casablanca. It produces quotes, invoices, credit notes and situations (progress per line and cumulative billing on a contract), fills a client's ICE, RC and address from the Moroccan registry, checks ICE format and applies TVA at 20, 14, 10, 7 or 0% line by line. It also covers expenses, suppliers, stock and recurring invoices.
pros: Published price: 450 DH a month excl. VAT with 2 users
Situations with progress per line and cumulative billing
Client ICE, RC and address filled from the registry
Unbroken invoice numbering and TVA by line
7-day free trial, no card
cons: Only 2 users included; more on quote
Trial limited to 3 invoices and 3 quotes
Data hosted in the EU (Ireland), not in Morocco
No DGI accreditation claimed
vendors.typical_pricing: Published: Aube Pro 450 DH a month excl. VAT (HT), per company, 2 users included, no commitment; 11% off when paid yearly. More users on quote. 7-day free trial limited to 3 invoices, 3 quotes and 5 situations.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Aube says its PDFs carry the mentions required by article 145 of the CGI (ICE, IF, RC, TVA detail, HT/TVA/TTC totals, payment terms), that invoice numbers run in an unbroken sequence and that it is ready for the 2026 electronic-invoicing roadmap. It does not claim DGI accreditation, and its privacy policy says data is hosted in Ireland.

vendors.name: Ciel Informatique
vendors.tagline: Logiciels Sage et EBP à Casablanca : vente, paramétrage, formation et assistance
vendors.market_position: Ciel Informatique is a Casablanca company that sells and supports business software, including Sage 50, Sage 100, Sage Batigest Connect and EBP, plus antivirus. It offers configuration, on-site or remote training, data import, document customization and support. The company says it has more than 30 years of experience, 15 experts and 5,000 customer accounts.
pros: Offers both Sage and EBP products, including Sage Batigest Connect
Configuration, training and data import services
Télédéclaration offer producing SIMPL files for TVA, IS and IR
Support by phone, e-mail, WhatsApp and Teams
cons: A reseller and service firm, not a software publisher
No public prices for software or services
Not on EBP Maroc's published reseller list
One listed office, in Casablanca
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices for software or services.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Ciel Informatique says its télédéclaration offer generates EDI (XML) files for the DGI's SIMPL-TVA, SIMPL-IS and SIMPL-IR services, covering TVA returns, the liasse fiscale and the état 9421. It is not on EBP Maroc's published reseller list, so EBP buyers can also compare EBP Maroc's listed partners.

vendors.name: Oasis Techno Cloud
vendors.tagline: Intégrateur Odoo Community au Maroc avec un pack BTP à prix publiés (MonChantier.ma)
vendors.market_position: Oasis Techno Cloud is a Moroccan firm that installs Odoo Community Edition, connects existing software and builds AI agents, with fixed-price packs for seven sectors. Its BTP pack, MonChantier.ma, is built on Odoo and covers projects, per-site budgets, materials stock, situations de travaux with retention, subcontractors and vehicle fleet. It is not on Odoo's list of official partners in Morocco.
pros: Published dirham prices for three BTP packs
Situations de travaux, retention and subcontractors in the BTP pack
Local installation or hosted cloud
No Odoo licence fees on Community Edition
Training and 30 days of support included
cons: Not listed as an official Odoo partner in Morocco
Moroccan accounting is an add-on to the BTP pack
Prices do not say whether VAT is included
Packs capped at 3, 5 or 10 users
No legal entity or address on the pages read
vendors.typical_pricing: Published in MAD (VAT treatment not stated). BTP packs, local installation, one-time: Chantier Simple 12,900 MAD (up to 3 users), BTP Complet 18,900 MAD (up to 5), Multi-Chantiers 24,900 MAD (up to 10). Hosted cloud: 3,900, 5,900 or 7,900 MAD setup plus 290, 390 or 590 MAD a month. Includes training and 30 days of support; maintenance plans extra.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Oasis Techno Cloud says a Moroccan accounting module (chart of accounts, TVA, IS, balance sheet) can be added to the BTP pack, that its hosted systems run on servers in Morocco, and that it prepares Maroc PME Mowakaba subsidy applications for clients free of charge. Check subsidy terms with Maroc PME directly.

vendors.name: Datao
vendors.tagline: Veille IA des appels d'offres publics au Maroc, travaux BTP compris
vendors.market_position: Datao, run by UXS SARL AU in Rabat, is an AI platform for monitoring Moroccan public tenders in works (BTP, infrastructure), services and supplies. Datao says it tracks more than 50,000 tenders a year from 300 official sources. It summarizes each tender, answers questions from the CPS documents, reads bills of quantities line by line and tracks contract awards by competitor.
pros: Published prices, from 490 DH a month excl. VAT
AI summaries and questions on tender documents (CPS)
Line-by-line search of bordereaux des prix
Award history and alerts by competitor
Alerts by keyword, sector, region and buyer
cons: Public tenders only, not private renovation leads
Paid yearly by bank transfer only for now
Solo plan includes 1 user
Free trial is arranged through a demo
vendors.typical_pricing: Published, excl. VAT (HT), paid yearly: Solo 490 DH a month (5,880 DH a year, 1 user), Pro 790 DH a month (9,480 DH a year, 5 users). Extra users 50 DH HT a month each. 7-day free trial. Annual bank transfer only for now.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Datao says it covers more than 50,000 Moroccan public tenders a year from 300 official sources, in works, services and supplies, and supports French and Arabic. It does not describe matching tenders to a firm's qualification and classification certificate, so check eligibility for each marché yourself.

vendors.name: Aljady
vendors.tagline: Veille des marchés publics marocains avec alertes IA
vendors.market_position: Aljady is a Moroccan public-procurement monitoring service. Its legal notice names Side Invest SARL AU as publisher, while its CGV name AVIVO SOLUTIONS SARL AU (Casablanca) as the company that publishes and sells the service. It sends AI-personalised alerts on tenders from the public procurement portal, extracts the price schedules (bordereaux de prix), lots and quantities from tender documents, and shows competitors' submission history, success rates and average amounts. The site shows more than 110,000 archived tenders and more than 4,000 open tenders, with construction, electrical works and water and sanitation among the sectors covered.
pros: Published monthly and yearly prices
7-day free trial without a bank card
Extracts bordereaux de prix, lots and quantities from tender documents
Competitor submission history and success rates
Free reference-price calculator
cons: Covers all sectors, not only construction
Public tenders only, no private-sector leads
Site in French only
Multi-user access only on the custom Entreprise plan
vendors.typical_pricing: Essentiel 590 MAD HT per month or 6,000 MAD HT per year (3 sectors); Pro 990 MAD HT per month or 10,000 MAD HT per year (5 sectors); Entreprise on quote. VAT at 20% is added. 7-day free trial.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Aljady says it extracts the bordereaux de prix, lots and quantities from Moroccan public tender files and shows which companies bid and how often they win, which helps when preparing a public-works bid. Payment is by bank transfer, per its CGV.

vendors.name: Sabab.ma
vendors.tagline: Trouvez un plombier, un électricien ou un artisan près de chez vous au Maroc
vendors.market_position: Sabab.ma is a Moroccan mobile app that lists nearby workers in 8 trades, including plumbers, electricians, air-conditioning technicians, painters and masons, sorted by distance. Clients call or WhatsApp the worker directly; there is no booking and, per its terms, no payment inside the app. Workers create a profile with their trade, photos and location, and Sabab says each profile's phone number is verified before publication.
pros: Trades-focused catalogue (plumbing, electrical, air conditioning, painting, masonry)
Free for clients to download, search and view profiles
Direct phone or WhatsApp contact, no booking step
iOS and Android apps, French and Arabic
cons: No fees or plans for professionals published
Consumer jobs, not B2B projects
Includes cleaning, moving and gardening
Terms name no company or address, only a contact email
vendors.typical_pricing: Free for clients (download, search and profile viewing). No prices for professionals published; the terms say Sabab processes no payments in the app.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Sabab shows profiles by distance and lets the client call or WhatsApp the worker directly, so for a Moroccan tradesperson it works as a free-to-browse visibility listing rather than a paid lead channel. Sabab says it verifies each worker's phone number but gives no quality guarantee.

vendors.name: Bricole
vendors.tagline: Votre artisan, à portée de main
vendors.market_position: Bricole is a free Android app that lists home-service professionals in Morocco and Egypt, with construction, repair and installation, and decoration among its categories alongside household, transport and beauty services. Bricole says it has 26K+ registered professionals, 160+ services and 100K+ downloads. Clients contact professionals directly and agree the price with them; Bricole takes no commission and handles no payment.
pros: Free for clients and professionals: no subscription, no commission
Construction, repair and installation among the main categories
Bricole says it has 26K+ registered professionals, with city counts on its site
Reviews tied to a QR code scanned after each job, Bricole says
Arabic and French
cons: Terms say Bricole does not verify identity, qualifications or insurance
Mixes trades with cleaning, beauty and other services
Android only; no iOS app mentioned
No operating company or address named on the site
vendors.typical_pricing: Free for clients and professionals: no subscription, no commission and no payment handled by Bricole (vendor FAQ and terms).
vendors.ma_specific_note: Bricole lists professionals by city (it shows 11,000+ in Casablanca and 4,900+ in Marrakech), and a Moroccan tradesperson can join for free and deal with clients directly. Because Bricole charges nothing, it is a visibility listing rather than a paid lead source.

vendors.name: Allopro (ex-Bricall)
vendors.tagline: Plateforme marocaine de services à domicile : jusqu'à 5 devis de maalems
vendors.market_position: Allopro (page title still 'Bricall') is a Moroccan home-services directory where clients describe a job and receive up to 5 quotes from providers, and providers pay for listing packs that add listings, visibility and badges. It covers 15 cities and lists 213+ providers, with fit-out, electrical, plumbing, repairs, painting and renovation the largest categories on 2026-09-30. Payment for the work goes directly from client to provider.
pros: Published prices, with a free Starter listing
Clients can receive up to 5 quotes for one job
Trades are the largest categories (fit-out, electrical, plumbing, painting)
Providers register with a CIN and a verified phone, per the terms
15 cities, French and Arabic
cons: Packs buy visibility, not guaranteed leads
Packs are not refundable once activated
Small provider base (213+ listed)
Mixes trades with cleaning, events, lessons and moving
vendors.typical_pricing: Starter free (1 listing, 7 days); Base 99 DH per month; Pro 199 DH per month; Master 399 DH per month. Add-ons from 19 DH (urgent badge) to 149 DH one-off (Verification+). The terms say invoices include VAT and the fiscal stamp.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Allopro sells monthly listing packs in dirhams (99 to 399 DH) that raise a maalem's visibility and show the phone number, and clients can get up to 5 quotes per request. Packs can be paid by card, bank transfer or cash, and the terms say they are not refundable once activated.

vendors.name: Bricoul.ma
vendors.tagline: Connecter particuliers et artisans vérifiés au Maroc
vendors.market_position: Bricoul.ma is a Moroccan directory of artisans (plumbers, electricians, painters, carpenters, air-conditioning, aluminium and glazing workers) that clients search by trade, city and neighbourhood. Artisans get a free Basic profile capped at 10 leads a month, or pay for Pro and Premium plans that remove the cap and raise their ranking. Bricoul says all artisans pass a KYC check on their CIN and RC or auto-entrepreneur status.
pros: Published prices, with a free Basic plan
Trades-focused catalogue
Bricoul says every artisan passes CIN and RC checks
Paid plans give unlimited leads and higher ranking
French and Arabic
cons: Terms leave the company's RC number blank
No mobile app mentioned
Coverage beyond Casablanca not confirmed
Annual prices not shown
vendors.typical_pricing: Basic free (up to 10 leads a month); Pro 99 MAD per month; Premium 199 MAD per month; prices TTC including 20% VAT. Annual billing saves two months, per the site.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Bricoul asks artisans for a Moroccan CIN, an RC or auto-entrepreneur status and a photo holding the CIN before listing them, so an unregistered worker cannot join. The Pro plan at 99 MAD a month lifts the 10-lead monthly cap of the free plan.

vendors.name: Wafa Assurance
vendors.tagline: Tous Risques Chantier et RC décennale pour les professionnels du BTP
vendors.market_position: Wafa Assurance, which says it is a subsidiary of the Attijariwafa bank group, sells Tous Risques Chantier cover to public and private BTP firms of any size, covering damage to the works and the civil liability of everyone on site. It also sells RC décennale against collapse for ten years from reception, plus Tous Risques Montage and machinery-breakdown cover. Cover is arranged through its advisers and no prices are published.
pros: Both main construction covers: TRC and RC décennale
TRC covers the liability of every party on site
Related lines: Tous Risques Montage, machinery breakdown, RC after works
Licensed insurer on the ACAPS list
cons: No published prices; quote through an adviser
No online quote seen
Décennale cover depends on checks by an approved technical-control body
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices. Contact a Wafa Assurance adviser for a quote per project.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Wafa's RC décennale page cites article 769 of the DOC and law 59-13 and says the cover depends on the works being checked by an approved technical-control body, so book the contrôle technique before asking for cover. Moroccan press reported in January 2025 that TRC and RC décennale insurance had become mandatory.

vendors.name: RMA (Royale Marocaine d’Assurance)
vendors.tagline: Assureur marocain avec une offre BTP : chantier et décennale
vendors.market_position: RMA (Royale Marocaine d'Assurance SA, Casablanca) is a licensed Moroccan insurer that says it has more than 300 points of sale across Morocco. Its business site has a BTP section listing Tous Risques Chantier and RC décennale cover for construction firms. No prices are published.
pros: Licensed insurer on the ACAPS list
BTP section covering Tous Risques Chantier and RC décennale
More than 300 points of sale across Morocco, RMA says
cons: No published prices
BTP page works only with JavaScript; cover details not confirmed here
Ask the insurer what technical checks the décennale cover requires
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices.
vendors.ma_specific_note: RMA lists TRC and RC décennale in the BTP section of its business site. Moroccan press reported in January 2025 that both covers had become mandatory for construction, so ask for both in one quote and check the conditions before the works start.

vendors.name: AtlantaSanad Assurance
vendors.tagline: Tous Risques Chantiers et RC décennale pour les professionnels
vendors.market_position: AtlantaSanad Assurance is a licensed Moroccan insurer formed by the 2020 merger of Atlanta and Sanad. Its professional and business range includes a Tous Risques Chantiers policy and an RC décennale product, alongside machinery-breakdown, workplace-accident and fleet cover. No prices are published.
pros: Licensed insurer on the ACAPS list
Both main construction covers: TRC and RC décennale
Related lines for contractors: machinery breakdown, workplace accidents, fleet
cons: No published prices
Product pages work only with JavaScript; cover details not confirmed here
The frozen link points to an old page address
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices.
vendors.ma_specific_note: AtlantaSanad lists a separate RC décennale product (its page address names it 'Albinna') next to its Tous Risques Chantiers policy. Moroccan press reported in January 2025 that both covers had become mandatory, so ask for both and check the technical-control conditions.

vendors.name: AXA Assurance Maroc
vendors.tagline: « TR Chantier Batissur » : tous risques chantier pour le BTP
vendors.market_position: AXA Assurance Maroc, which presents itself as part of the AXA Group, sells TR Chantier Batissur, a construction all-risks policy for project owners, developers, contractors, architects and design offices. It covers damage to the works, workmanship errors, site machinery, third-party liability and debris removal until provisional reception, and a post-reception guarantee period can be added. Its business range also includes the Mihnassur multirisk policy for professionals; no décennale product is listed on its site.
pros: Named construction all-risks product (Batissur)
Covers workmanship errors, site machinery and third-party liability
Optional post-reception guarantee period
Licensed insurer on the ACAPS list
cons: No RC décennale product listed on axa.ma
No published prices
Quote by callback request or through an agency
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Batissur covers the works until provisional reception, with an optional post-reception period for defects found after handover. AXA Maroc's site lists no RC décennale product, so a contractor who needs décennale cover should ask the agency directly or look at other insurers.

vendors.name: Sanlam Maroc (formerly Allianz Maroc)
vendors.tagline: Allianz Maroc est devenue Sanlam : Tous Risques Chantier et RC décennale
vendors.market_position: Allianz Maroc was absorbed by Sanlam Maroc in July 2026 and now operates under the Sanlam brand; Sanlam says existing Allianz policies stay valid until expiry on the same terms and with the same intermediary. Sanlam Maroc sells Tous Risques Chantier cover for the duration of construction works and RC décennale covering damage to a building's solidity for 10 years after delivery, for architects, contractors, artisans and developers. No prices are published.
pros: Both main construction covers: TRC and RC décennale
Décennale page lists collapse, cracks, water ingress and waterproofing failures
Existing Allianz policies stay valid until expiry, Sanlam says
Online quote request plus agent network
cons: The Allianz brand no longer operates in Morocco; policies move to Sanlam
No published prices
Old Allianz BTP page still online with outdated branding
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices. Sanlam offers a quote request form and its agents.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Sanlam's RC décennale page says the cover is obligatoire for architects, maîtres d'œuvre, contractors, artisans and developers and runs for 10 years after delivery. A contractor insured with Allianz Maroc keeps the same policy and intermediary until renewal, per Sanlam's notice.

vendors.name: Sage Paie & RH Maroc (Sage 100)
vendors.tagline: Sage 100 Paie & RH: Sage's payroll and HR software for Moroccan firms
vendors.market_position: Sage 100 Paie & RH is sold in Morocco by Sage, whose parent company, The Sage Group plc, is registered in Newcastle upon Tyne, UK. Sage says it produces the Moroccan social declarations (CNSS, CIMR, CNRA) and tax declarations (IR and the déclaration employeur), with legal updates installed automatically. Sage also sells an accountant edition, Sage 100 Paie & RH Experts, and HR add-ons such as Sage 100 Suite RH.
pros: CNSS, CIMR, CNRA and IR declarations generated from payroll, per Sage
Legal updates installed automatically, per Sage
Accountant edition available for firms whose payroll is run by an accountant
Sage has operated in Morocco as Sage Maroc since at least 2015, per press coverage
cons: No public prices on Sage Morocco pages
No BTP-specific payroll features described on the pages found
Damancom file handling not described on the pages found; confirm with Sage
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices on Sage Morocco pages.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Sage says Sage 100 Paie & RH produces the Moroccan CNSS, CIMR, CNRA and IR declarations. Ask Sage or your accountant how the CNSS file is submitted through Damancom and how site-based crews are handled before you buy.

vendors.name: OJRA : Paie Maroc (NSE)
vendors.tagline: Windows payroll software from Casablanca-based NSE, with built-in Damancom and Simpl-IR files
vendors.market_position: OJRA is payroll and personnel software from NSE (Network and Software Engineering), a Casablanca software house that also sells accounting and commercial-management software. NSE says OJRA follows Moroccan legal rules, computes CNSS, AMO, CIMR and IR deductions, and has native modules for Damancom (CNSS), Simpl-IR salary declarations and CIMR télédéclaration. It runs in Windows and links to Excel and NSE's own KHABIR accounting software.
pros: Native Damancom module for CNSS declarations, per NSE
Simpl-IR XML files for the DGI salary declaration
Version 2026 covers the January 2026 SMIG rise and 2026 Finance Law IR changes, per NSE
Special rates for fiduciaires and accountants
cons: No public prices; quote on request
Windows desktop software; no cloud version described
No BTP-specific features such as site time tracking described
vendors.typical_pricing: Quote-based; no public prices (free quote on request, special rates for accounting-firm partners).
vendors.ma_specific_note: NSE says OJRA's Damancom module is built in, producing the monthly CNSS declaration file and importing the eBDS file, and a separate Simpl-IR module produces the XML file for the DGI salary declaration. Check how it handles site-based crews before you buy, as the page describes general payroll only.

vendors.name: Humantal
vendors.tagline: Moroccan payroll and HR software with automatic CNSS, AMO and IR calculations and Damancom filing
vendors.market_position: Humantal sells payroll and HR software built for Moroccan labour law. Its site says it calculates CNSS, AMO and IR automatically, sends CNSS declarations through the Damancom portal, and syncs leave with payroll, and that more than 300 Moroccan companies use it. It is a general payroll product: its site does not describe features for construction crews or site-based work. Prices are given after a demo.
pros: Built for Moroccan payroll: CNSS, AMO and IR calculations, per Humantal
Damancom declarations sent from the software, per Humantal
Leave requests handled online and synced with payroll
Free demo, no commitment and free migration from Excel, per its site
cons: No public prices: pricing comes after a demo
No construction or site-crew features described
Customer figures and ratings on its site are its own claims
vendors.typical_pricing: No public prices; Humantal offers a free demo and says there is no commitment.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Humantal says it produces CNSS declarations for Damancom and applies the 2026 CNSS, AMO and IR rates automatically; ask in the demo how it handles crews that move between sites and the DGI salary declaration.

vendors.name: Qualification & Classification des Entreprises de BTP
vendors.tagline: The Ministry of Equipment and Water's qualification and classification system for construction firms
vendors.market_position: Morocco's system of qualification and classification of building and public works (BTP) firms was set up by Décret n° 2-94-223 of 16 June 1994 and is run by the Ministère de l'Équipement et de l'Eau through national and regional commissions. For each sector of activity it defines classes, the thresholds for each class and the maximum annual contract amount a firm of that class can be admitted to bid for. Since 2020 applications are filed online, and part of the work has moved to the ministry's regional directorates.
pros: Sets the size of public works contracts a firm can bid for
Online filing and tracking of applications since 2020
Applications handled by regional as well as national commissions
The ministry publishes a list of qualified and classified firms
cons: A firm's class caps the contract size it can bid for
Applications are reviewed by ministry commissions, so apply well before a tender
Fees and certificate validity not published on the pages checked
A reform to unify the system has been under study since 2019
vendors.typical_pricing: No official fee schedule found on the ministry pages checked.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Check each public tender file for the sector, qualification and class it asks for. The class you hold sets the maximum contract amount you can bid for, and the classes include a class S.

vendors.name: CNSS : Immatriculation employeur + Damancom
vendors.tagline: Morocco's social security fund for employees, with Damancom for monthly declarations
vendors.market_position: The Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS) is the Moroccan social security fund to which employers declare their salaried workers; 4.08 million were declared at the end of 2024, per Hespress. It runs the mandatory health insurance (AMO) for salaried workers. Affiliated employers declare salaries and pay contributions online through its Damancom portal, which moved to two-factor sign-in in 2025.
pros: Gives employees AMO health cover through the CNSS
Declarations and payments are made online through Damancom
Moroccan payroll software such as OJRA produces Damancom files
An up-to-date CNSS certificate keeps you eligible for public tenders
cons: Monthly declarations and payments to keep up
Damancom sign-in needs two-factor authentication (e-ID or a code by SMS or email)
CNSS arrears can get a bidder excluded from public tenders
Contribution rates are set by law; check current rates with the CNSS
vendors.typical_pricing: No registration fee found; contributions are due on pay at statutory rates (check current rates with the CNSS).
vendors.ma_specific_note: Public tender rules (Décret n° 2-22-431, article 28, as reported by Hespress in January 2025) ask bidders for a CNSS certificate issued within the last year, and bid commissions have been told to check CNSS arrears. Keep your Damancom declarations and payments current before you bid.

vendors.name: ICE : Identifiant Commun de l’Entreprise
vendors.tagline: Morocco's common business identifier, mandatory on official documents since July 2016
vendors.market_position: The Identifiant Commun de l'Entreprise (ICE) is a single identifier for a Moroccan business, shared across administrations. The Direction Générale des Impôts led the project and hosts its database, working with OMPIC, the CNSS and other bodies, and OMPIC announced the ICE as mandatory from 1 July 2016. Existing businesses can obtain their ICE on www.ice.gov.ma, and OMPIC's company records show it next to the RC number.
pros: One identifier shared across administrations
Shown on OMPIC company records next to the RC number
Existing businesses can obtain it online at www.ice.gov.ma
Invoices bearing it are accepted by the tax administration, per Hespress
cons: Must appear on official documents
Invoices without it can be rejected by the tax administration, per Hespress
Does not replace the IF (tax ID) or the RC number
Check its format and any fee on the official ICE portal
vendors.typical_pricing: No official fee found on the pages checked.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Put your ICE on your invoices: Hespress reported in July 2025 that the tax administration accepts only invoices that carry it. E-invoicing is due to start in phases from late 2026, beginning with large companies and suppliers to the public sector (Hespress, August 2026), so choose invoicing software that stores your ICE and your clients' ICE numbers.

vendors.name: Registre de Commerce (RC) : OMPIC
vendors.tagline: Morocco's trade register, filed with the court registries and centralised by OMPIC
vendors.market_position: Moroccan businesses are entered in the Registre de Commerce (RC) through the registry (greffe) of the competent court, and OMPIC keeps the central trade register that brings these filings together. OMPIC's Directinfo site offers a free search of the central register and sells copies of filed documents such as statutes and financial statements. The CRI of Casablanca-Settat says the Direct Entreprise platform is now the official route for company creation procedures.
pros: Free search of the central trade register on OMPIC's Directinfo site
Records show the RC number, court, ICE, capital and whether a firm is active
Certificat négatif requests can be made online with OMPIC
Company creation procedures run through the Direct Entreprise platform
cons: Registration and later changes are filed with the court registry
Filed statutes and financial statements can be bought by anyone on Directinfo
No official fee schedule found on the pages checked
vendors.typical_pricing: No official fee schedule found on the pages checked; Directinfo searches are free and filed documents are sold per item.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Before you sign with a client or subcontractor, look them up on Directinfo: the free search shows whether the firm is registered and still active, with its RC number, court and ICE.

vendors.name: DGI : Identifiant Fiscal (IF) & portail SIMPL
vendors.tagline: Tax identification (IF) and SIMPL online tax services from Morocco's tax authority
vendors.market_position: The Direction Générale des Impôts (DGI) registers taxpayers for an identifiant fiscal (IF) and runs SIMPL, its online services for professionals, including SIMPL-IS, SIMPL-TVA and SIMPL-IR channels for corporate tax, VAT and salary declarations. The DGI is also preparing electronic invoicing, which Hespress reported in August 2026 will start in phases from the end of 2026, beginning with large companies and suppliers to the public sector.
pros: Online filing through SIMPL for corporate tax, VAT and salary declarations
Tax certificates and a tax account available online
Payroll and accounting software can produce SIMPL EDI files
Company search (Recherche Entreprise) on the DGI site
cons: Filing deadlines and penalties to track
Tax rules change with each Finance Law, as IR did in 2026
E-invoicing is coming in phases and the technical rules were not yet published in August 2026
vendors.typical_pricing: No DGI fee found for the IF or SIMPL; taxes are due under the Code Général des Impôts.
vendors.ma_specific_note: Your IF and ICE go on supplier forms and invoices, and SIMPL is where TVA, IS and salary declarations are filed. E-invoicing is due to start in phases from late 2026, large companies and public-sector suppliers first (Hespress, August 2026), so ask your invoicing software provider how it will connect once the DGI publishes the technical rules.
